hints.title: Peak Invariant
hints.text: An element at index i is a peak if 0 < i < n - 1, nums[i] > nums[i - 1], and nums[i] > nums[i + 1].

hints.title: Subarray Boundary Exclusions
hints.text: For query [1, l, r], elements at indices l and r can never be peaks within the subarray [l, r], so query the count in range [l + 1, r - 1].

hints.title: Fenwick Tree Updates
hints.text: When index is updated, only indices index - 1, index, and index + 1 can change their peak status. Update their binary indexed tree positions.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Fenwick tree point updates and range sum queries run in logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning subarray peaks for every query takes O(n * q) which exceeds time limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain dynamic point flags with Fenwick tree and handle boundary edge conditions correctly.
